description:
The influencer era is over.

People are tired of promo codes, highlight reels, and perfectly curated content that feels impossible to relate to.

They're not buying because you're not giving them a reason to care.

Here's what people actually want:

Connection.
Belonging.
A story worth following.

This is why running clubs, retreats, and online communities are blowing up right now.

People aren't looking for the next Beyoncé. They're looking for someone real.

There's a cinnamon roll shop called @rollboysldn that has lines out the door every single day.

You can get cinnamon rolls anywhere, but people choose them because of their story.

They shared the messy behind-the-scenes—the failures, the bad days, the wins and built a movement people wanted to be part of.

That's branding.

If you want to build something that lasts, stop performing and start building community.

Share why you're doing this. What's your compelling message? Your contrarian belief? The gap you're here to fill?

Give people a reason to rally behind you.

Attention spans are short, but a real story, that makes people stop scrolling. 🔥
